cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Still a Good Sign
cards.instruction: Treat every awkward or disappointing interaction as proof that the connection remains alive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put a question mark on Friday like you. Keeping each other guessing. You still make dinner feel like an occasion.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It means I can't promise. I've cancelled three times already.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, no promises. But you're still worrying about letting me down; that's something.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Please stop keeping Fridays free for me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Looking after my weekends now. I'll make other plans; you always did hate seeing me stuck at home.
